description.value: Game On Sports Bar & Grill is a full-service restaurant and sports bar in Merritt, BC, sitting at a natural crossroads for cyclists traveling the Nicola Valley corridor between the Coast Mountains and the Okanagan. The venue pours 8 beers on tap alongside a broad pub menu spanning burgers, seafood, appetizers, and house-made cocktails. Rotating themed events — including Nova Scotia lobster nights and Wednesday prime rib features — give it a lively, community-focused character.
